answer: Price every identity to a scarce hardware anchor, then let standing grow only when several already-established peers from separate funding clusters co-sign its audited work. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet shares one root, so its endorsements never bridge the delta between distinct clusters; they only pool back on themselves. Honest agents spread like trees across a wide orchard, each rooted in its own soil, so 100 fakes cost 100 anchors plus 100 slow climbs while honest pays once.
